externals.name: Risk
externals.summary: Scores a login attempt before auth issues a session. Nobody in the estate provides it; the copy of its contract beside auth's adapter is narrowed to the one rpc auth runs, and is all the catalog claims about it.

methods.name: Assess
methods.doc: Assess says whether a login attempt should go ahead.

fields.name: user_id
fields.doc:
The user the attempt is for. Auth has already checked the credentials by
the time it asks; risk decides whether that is enough today.

enums.name: Verdict
enums.doc:
Verdict is closed on purpose: a caller switches on it, and a new value is a
contract change rather than a string somebody starts sending.

values.name: VERDICT_BLOCK
values.doc: Refuse the attempt and treat the account as compromised.
